headline: Superintendent presents 5-year budget projection: $20 million deficit from Student Opportunity Act sunset, 800 fewer students
summary: The Student Opportunity Act grant ends in June 2027, and the enrollment drop will affect the 27-28 school year. Options named include reviewing vacancies, charter tuition, and leased buildings. A working session for all members may be held before the end of the year. The FY 2027 amended budget was also recommended to the full committee.
decisions: Recommended the FY 2027 amended budget to the full committee, 3-0.
discussion: Five-year budget projection: The superintendent presented a $20 million deficit from the Student Opportunity Act sunset, plus about 800 fewer students this year, worth about $20 million in funding. Members asked where the students went, and the superintendent said the district usually confirms where students enroll, though a few families who leave the state cannot be found.

Enrollment drop and census: Concern was raised that students who leave may not be enrolled elsewhere, and that census counts affect funding. The superintendent said the district is exploring whether immigration enforcement has affected enrollment, but the cause is still to be determined.

Closing the gap: The superintendent said cuts would be made as far from the classroom as possible, and listed reviewing vacancies, charter and out-of-district tuition, and facilities. Concern was raised that closing or merging schools has drawn scrutiny and outcry in nearby districts.

Recruiting students and outreach: The superintendent described a reverse recruitment campaign started last year, plus a marketing campaign and more talks with parents. Members urged a community call to action and more notice of meetings, including through neighborhood councils.

Working session on the shortfall: The attorney said a working session would be held in open session unless a legal reason for executive session arose. Members asked for wider advertising so residents know about it in advance.

decision_evidence.quote: vote to recommend to the full committee the approval of FY 2027 amended budget. ... Yes, more than sufficient votes. This matter passes.
